comment.value:
This manuscript proposes a sample complexity which relies on a tensor concentration inequality Theorem 3 in

M. Even and L. Massoulié. Concentration of non-isotropic random tensors with applications to learning and empirical risk minimization. In Conference on Learning Theory, pages 1847–1886. PMLR, 2021.

which is false. Since COLT did not publish an erratum, we did not know.
